text:
maya: heads-up — started seeing a spike of 413s from the /embeddings route for a single customer. samples show mixed-dim arrays (1536 + 12288) in the same request.
josh: ouch. are we rejecting upstream or in the splitter? any logs?
maya: splitter logs: `ERROR split_payload: chunk_size_bytes > MAX_PAYLOAD` but payload bytes were only ~3.4MB. dims mismatch caused extra bookkeeping, made splitting blow up.
priya: is this the case where our splitter assumes uniform dim per batch? iirc we only optimize for homogeneous dims in fast-path.
liam: correct. current policy: if mixed dims -> fall back to per-item RPC, which inflates size because we embed headers per item. if combined with large text fields, we hit 413.
maya: question: should routing policy send mixed-dim requests to the 'flex' pool (more tolerant, higher mem) or pre-split into homogeneous batches on the API side? i'm leaning API-side preflight that rewrites to multiple sub-requests + preserves order.
josh: API rewrite seems nicer UX (transparent) but we need quota accounting that maps sub-requests back to original request for console usage and billing.
priya: +1 for API-side split. but we must emit telemetry events: preflight.split_count, preflight.rewrite_bytes, original_request_id so console can tie metrics back.
liam: also add a metric for "dims_vary" boolean and a histogram of dims_per_request. that will help routing decisions and autoscaling.
quota-bot: notice: last 24h we billed one customer ~4x cost due to per-item fallback for mixed dims. Recommend quota-alert threshold: preflight.rewrites > 1000/day -> send ops alert.
maya: for console UX — can we show a little banner on the request details: "This request was auto-split into N sub-requests (see telemetry)" and link to a explain doc.
priya: ops nuance: when we split at API, we should apply original customer quotas to the whole operation atomically. otherwise a partial fail will be confusing.
liam: atomic quota check + two-phase commit is heavy. alternative: preflight quota reservation: reserve token_count for eventual sub-requests, then decrement as subrequests complete.
josh: we'll need new API: POST /embeddings:preflight -> returns plan { shards:[{dim,count,bytes}], total_reserved } and a plan_id. then caller can submit with header X-Preflight-Plan: <plan_id>.
maya: sample preflight response we sketched:
```
{
  "plan_id": "pf_01G...",
  "shards": [ {"dim":1536, "count":12, "bytes":1200000}, {"dim":12288, "count":2, "bytes":2100000} ],
  "total_bytes":3300000
}
```
priya: Nice. console: show plan_id and expand to see per-shard latency estimates and cost delta vs single-model fallback.
liam: backend concern: routing rules need to prefer quantized 8-bit pool for 1536 dims and fp16 for 12288. add rule: route_by_dim_thresholds: { "<4096": pool-A, ">=4096": pool-B }
josh: ok. rollout plan: feature-flag preflight API to 10% of orgs, enable auto-split only for orgs that opt-in. Console toggle under "Embeddings -> Preflight & Split".
maya: tests to add: random mixed-dim batch generator, validate order preserved, quota reservation race tests, failure retry semantics.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: embed-splitter v2 -> staging (ci/1234) :rocket:
maya: i'll draft a small RFC and a console mock for the banner + plan UI. tagging @priya and @liam for implementation pairing.
priya: cool, i'll start on telemetry events and quota reservation sketch.
josh: i'll do API + splitter changes. will wire metrics to per-route dashboard and add a small panel: dims_per_request heatmap.
liam: ping me when you have the plan API; i'll wire routing rules and pool mappings.
maya: thanks all. filing follow-ups: create GH tickets for preflight API, console banner, quota-reservation, metrics dashboard.
